post.title: 5 Signs Your New Habit Is Actually Working #shorts
post.description: How many did you check? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend on day 22 of anything. June's new running habit is on day 22 and it still feels like work, because '21 days' was supposed to make it automatic. That number traces back to a 1960 self-help book by a plastic surgeon (Maxwell Maltz, Psycho-Cybernetics), who noticed patients took about three weeks to get used to their new look; it was never a habit study. In 'How Are Habits Formed: Modelling Habit Formation in the Real World' (European Journal of Social Psychology, 2010), Phillippa Lally, Cornelia van Jaarsveld, Henry Potts and Jane Wardle had 96 volunteers repeat a new daily behaviour: reaching peak automaticity took 66 days on average, from 18 days to far longer, and a single missed day had little effect. You're not late. The rule was wrong. #psychology #shorts #habits #21days #overthinking
